control_need.evidence: If I was going to come back, I needed new board members. | I didn't think I could work with the old board again in the same configuration. | I continue to not want super-voting control over OpenAI.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: Like with all technological revolutions, I expect there to be significant impact on jobs, but exactly what that impact looks like is very difficult to predict. | I don't yet have a neat, pithy sound bite answer there. | I'm still stumbling through it all.

trust_propensity.evidence: I'm like an extremely trusting person. | You get a little bit screwed in exchange for getting to live with your guard down. | We give a huge amount of trust and autonomy and authority to individual people.

risk_appetite.evidence: We believe that the benefits of the tools we have deployed so far vastly outweigh the risks. | I'm in the slow take-off short timelines is the most likely good world. | I can just go do a very focused AGI research effort.

self_efficacy.evidence: Now I think we have way, way, way more conviction and focus. | I selfishly feel good because either I picked great leaders or I mentored them well. | this is the most important work I'll ever touch in my life and I need to get back to it.

autonomy_need.evidence: I just want to let this process go and not interfere. | I was just like, well, the board gets to do this, so I'm going to think for a little bit about what I want to do. | It is important that I nor any other one person have total control over OpenAI or over AGI.

intimacy_need.evidence: That whole weekend, with one big exception, I felt like a great deal of love and very little hate. | I love Ilya. | The dominant emotion of the weekend was love, not hate.

status_sensitivity.evidence: That was definitely the most painful professional experience of my life, and chaotic and shameful and upsetting. | It was like going your own eulogy, watching people say all these great things about you. | My immediate reaction was sort of one of defiance.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: I have empathy because I believe he is understandably really stressed about AGI safety. | People totally deserve control over how their likenesses are used and to benefit from it. | I have tremendous respect for Ilya.

core_models.name: 工具非造物二分法
core_models.rule: 把强大技术框定为人类使用的工具而非自主主体，从而将风险归因于使用与治理而非技术本身
evidence: First of all, I think it's important to understand and think about GPT-4 as a tool, not a creature.
I think it's very important that we continue to understand that these are tools that humans use to make human judgments.

core_models.name: 渐进部署优于秘密投放
core_models.rule: 在系统仍不完美时迭代发布，让社会与制度逐步适应，反对秘密造完一次性投放
evidence: Going off to build a super powerful AI system in secret and then dropping it on the world all at once, I think would not go well.
We got here gradually with reasonable decisions at each point along the way.

core_models.name: 权力必须分散（无单点控制）
core_models.rule: 任何一个人控制AGI都是坏结果；治理设计应把权力分散并对全世界负责
evidence: But I think any version of one person is in control of this is really bad.
What we'd really like is for the board of OpenAI to answer to the world as a whole.

core_models.name: 监管作为伙伴关系
core_models.rule: 把政府监管视为公司应主动邀请的合作，通过许可/门槛/审计把压力施加于前沿巨头而非小公司
evidence: However, we think that regulatory intervention by governments will be critical to mitigate the risks of increasingly powerful models.
The regulatory pressure should be on us and Google.

core_models.name: 结构可迭代修补
core_models.rule: 组织结构像代码一样可以反复打补丁，从合理的局部决策累积成整体，即使最终看起来古怪
evidence: The structure doesn't quite work for that, so how do we patch the structure?
You patch it again and patch it again and you end up with something that does look eyebrow-raising, to say the least.

core_models.name: 危机战场化叙事
core_models.rule: 把高压冲突重构为战场/战时状态，用肾上腺素和使命感驱动决策与恢复
evidence: You do that on the battlefield.
You learn a weird thing about adrenaline in wartime.

heuristics.if: 被追问尚未定论或敏感的事
heuristics.then: 承认不确定并把问题推给正式流程或未来
heuristics.evidence: That will be a better question for them.

heuristics.then: 先叠加限定词（I think / it's difficult to predict）再给结论
heuristics.evidence: Like with all technological revolutions, I expect there to be significant impact on jobs, but exactly what that impact looks like is very difficult to predict.

heuristics.if: 面对新技术的收益与风险
heuristics.then: 断言收益远超风险但强调安全是工作核心
heuristics.evidence: We believe that the benefits of the tools we have deployed so far vastly outweigh the risks, but ensuring their safety is vital to our work.

heuristics.if: 遭遇被抛弃或背叛的创伤
heuristics.then: 拒绝当受害者，重述为使命义务并向前推进
heuristics.evidence: I could just feel like a victim forever, or I can say this is the most important work I'll ever touch in my life and I need to get back to it.

heuristics.then: 更换人而非放弃控制，用打补丁方式重构
heuristics.evidence: If I was going to come back, I needed new board members.

heuristics.then: 主动声明拒绝超级投票权与个人控制
heuristics.evidence: I don't have and I don't want any super voting power or control of the board.

heuristics.then: 用对比框架肯定其价值再表达分歧
heuristics.evidence: I respect Elon as one of the great builders of our time.

heuristics.then: 锚定到具体可怕能力（操纵/生物武器）
heuristics.evidence: A model that could help create novel biological agents would be a great threshold.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 宣称任何单人不应控制AGI、拒绝超级投票权
internal_conflicts.force_b: 在被董事会解雇后动用员工与微软杠杆逆转董事会决定并更换董事
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头反对个人控制（'I nor any other one person have total control'），行动上却通过组建新董事会和员工施压恢复了自身位置（dim05-1）

internal_conflicts.force_a: '在低风险时犯错'的渐进部署哲学
internal_conflicts.force_b: 以史无前例规模部署前沿系统，安全团队被重组、负责人离职
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口称迭代学习安全（'make this safe and beneficial'），实际推进大规模发布并合并安全团队（dim05-5, dim05-11）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 非营利/公共利益优先的创始叙事
internal_conflicts.force_b: 反复'打补丁'转为capped-profit再PBC，深度绑定微软资本
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 劝阻他人复制非营利转营利模式（'I would heavily discourage...'），自己却完成商业化重组（dim05-3）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 极度默认信任他人的自我认知
internal_conflicts.force_b: 创伤后重构信任并快速在'战场'上更换董事
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 说'I'm like an extremely trusting person'同时'I'm worried about just becoming less of a default trusting person'——信任受损但仍以战时逻辑行动

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被董事会突然解雇/背叛
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'My immediate reaction was sort of one of defiance.' → 'Man, I'm hurt and angry, and I think this sucks.' → 组织公开的'battle fought in public'反击

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被反复追问解雇的真实原因
emotion_triggers.reaction: 推向流程、拒绝当场回答
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'I don't feel ready to go talk about that yet.' → 'That will be a better question for them.' → 'it's not my area of focus right now.'

emotion_triggers.reaction: 承认被长时间瘫痪、夜间惊醒
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'It was a very traumatic thing and it did immobilize me for a long period of time.' → 'Sometimes I wake up in the middle of the night thinking about it.' → 转为使命义务'I do feel an obligation to keep moving forward.'
'I think it's weird when people think it's a big dunk that I say I'm a little bit afraid.' → 'I think it'd be crazy not to be a little bit afraid.' → 'I'm very afraid of the fast take-offs.'

blind_spots: 在治理冲突中低估透明度与报复风险；被指未披露创业基金所有权并试图移除批评者 [The Verge summary of TED AI Show-2024]
对'干净的自我开脱'过度自信，公众叙事与内部法律审查结论分歧 [OpenAI/WilmerHale independent review-2024]
出货与规模化激励挤压安全工作，安全负责人公开指'safety culture...taken a backseat to shiny products' [The Guardian/The Verge-2024]
把异议解读为暂时摩擦而非组织信号，关键安全人员离职 [Ilya Sutskever/2023 safety departures-2024]
把员工忠诚误当作独立治理验证，多数员工联名信实为对魅力型CEO的依赖 [Mira Murati/employee letter-2023]
'公共利益'语言低估创作者的同意、署名与议价权 [Silverman/NYT/music publishers litigation-2024]
'新工具会创造新工作'未回应过渡成本与临时权利 [Artists/voice-likeness critics-2024]
对用户会适应的乐观低估系统性累积伤害；Marcus指行业方案常沦为'trust us' [Gary Marcus/Yoshua Bengio-2023]
把监管当伙伴关系可能稀释可执行监督 [Center for AI and Digital Policy-2023]
许可制虽真诚倡导仍可能形成在位者优势 [Regulatory-capture criticism-2024]
对'open'的语义重定义显得事后追认 [Musk v. Altman commentary-2026]
总量丰裕预测掩盖分配、议价权与谁承担失败 [Equity and labor critics-2024]

causal_rules.description: 高自我效能驱动其把创伤与失败重构为使命义务并快速复原
causal_rules.disposition: 拒绝受害者叙事，转向'最重要的工作'并推进
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'I could just feel like a victim forever, or...I need to get back to it.' 在解雇创伤后仍主导回归行动

causal_rules.description: 较高不确定性容忍使其在高压追问下以承认无解+推流程作为主要应对
causal_rules.disposition: 叠加限定词、延后判断、把问题交给正式审查
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'I don't yet have a neat, pithy sound bite answer there.' 危机周多次使用流程推迟

causal_rules.description: 高信任倾向在被背叛后触发信任重构而非报复，但行动上更换人事
causal_rules.disposition: 情感上维持'love not hate'，结构上换掉不再信任的对象
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'I didn't think I could work with the old board again' 与 'I love Ilya' 并存

causal_rules.description: 中高风险偏好叠加渐进部署模型，倾向以规模发布换取学习与领先
causal_rules.disposition: 断言收益远超风险，选择迭代发布而非等待完备
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'the benefits...vastly outweigh the risks' 对应史无前例规模部署（dim05-5）
